ex.en: The architect showed us the blueprints of the house.
ex.zh: 建築師給我們看了房子的設計圖。

ex.en: The report is a blueprint for reform.
ex.zh: 這份報告是改革的藍圖。

blueprint.en: a detailed plan or drawing of how to build or do something

ex.en: I always need an extra blanket in the wintertime.
ex.zh: 冬天我總是需要多加一條毯子。

ex.en: Can you give me a pillow and a blanket?
ex.zh: 可以給我一個枕頭和一條毯子嗎？

ex.en: How many blankets are there on the bed?
ex.zh: 床上有幾條毯子？

blanket.en: a large piece of soft cloth that keeps you warm in bed

ex.en: Snow blanketed the city overnight.
ex.zh: 一夜之間，大雪覆蓋了整座城市。

ex.en: Thick fog blanketed the airport this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上濃霧籠罩了機場。

blanket.en: to cover something completely with a layer

ex.en: The company has a blanket ban on smoking.
ex.zh: 公司全面禁止吸菸。

ex.en: We can't apply a blanket rule to every case.
ex.zh: 我們不能把同一套規則套用到每個案例。

blanket.en: applying to everyone or everything without exceptions

ex.en: Fill in the blanks with suitable words.
ex.zh: 請用適當的字詞填空。

ex.en: Write your name in the blank at the top.
ex.zh: 把你的名字寫在上方的空格裡。

blank.en: an empty space on a form where you write something

ex.en: Please leave this page blank.
ex.zh: 這一頁請留白。

ex.en: I handed in a blank sheet of paper.
ex.zh: 我交了一張白紙。

blank.en: with nothing written or printed on it

blank.zh: （腦中）一片空白的；（表情）茫然的

ex.en: My mind was blank.
ex.zh: 我的腦袋一片空白。

ex.en: She gave me a blank look.
ex.zh: 她一臉茫然地看著我。

blank.en: showing no thought, feeling or understanding

ex.en: Blend the mixture together until it is smooth.
ex.zh: 把混合物攪拌到滑順為止。

ex.en: Oil and water won't blend with each other.
ex.zh: 油和水無法互相混合。

ex.en: Blend the fruit with some milk to make a smoothie.
ex.zh: 把水果和一些牛奶打在一起做成果昔。

blend.en: to mix different things together so they become one

ex.en: His black coat blended into the darkness.
ex.zh: 他的黑色外套和黑暗融為一體。

ex.en: The new employee blended in with the team quickly.
ex.zh: 新員工很快就融入了團隊。

blend.en: to look or seem so similar to the things around that it is hard to see

ex.en: This coffee is a blend of beans from Brazil and Kenya.
ex.zh: 這款咖啡混合了巴西和肯亞的豆子。

ex.en: The show offers a blend of music and comedy.
ex.zh: 這場表演結合了音樂和喜劇。

ex.en: Tom was injured in the blast.
ex.zh: 湯姆在爆炸中受傷。

ex.en: News of the recent blast is all over the radio.
ex.zh: 廣播裡全是最近那場爆炸的新聞。

blast.en: a sudden explosion that causes damage

ex.en: A blast of cold air swept through the house.
ex.zh: 一陣冷風吹過整間房子。

ex.en: An icy blast of wind chilled me to the bone.
ex.zh: 一陣冰冷的強風讓我冷到骨子裡。

blast.en: a sudden strong movement of air

ex.en: My neighbor blasts music late at night.
ex.zh: 我鄰居半夜把音樂開得很大聲。

ex.en: The radio was blasting pop songs all day.
ex.zh: 收音機整天大聲播著流行歌。

blast.en: to play music or sound at a very loud volume

ex.en: We had a blast at the party last night.
ex.zh: 我們昨晚在派對上玩得超開心。

ex.en: The kids had a blast at the water park.
ex.zh: 孩子們在水上樂園玩得很盡興。

blast.en: to have a very enjoyable time

ex.en: We have three dogs, one white and two black.
ex.zh: 我們有三隻狗，一隻白的、兩隻黑的。

ex.en: I have a black dog and a white dog.
ex.zh: 我有一隻黑狗和一隻白狗。

ex.en: I don't believe that black cats cause bad luck.
ex.zh: 我不相信黑貓會帶來厄運。

black.en: having the darkest color, like coal at night

ex.en: How do you like your coffee? Strong and black?
ex.zh: 你的咖啡要怎麼喝？濃的黑咖啡嗎？

ex.en: I always drink my coffee black.
ex.zh: 我喝咖啡都不加奶。

ex.en: She was dressed in black.
ex.zh: 她穿著一身黑。

ex.en: Black is my favorite color.
ex.zh: 黑色是我最喜歡的顏色。

black.en: the darkest color, like coal at night

ex.en: I would like to try the blue striped skirt.
ex.zh: 我想試穿那件藍色條紋裙。

ex.en: A white cloud is floating in the blue sky.
ex.zh: 一朵白雲在藍天上飄。

blue.en: having the color of a clear sky

ex.en: He thinks that blue is the most beautiful colour.
ex.zh: 他覺得藍色是最美的顏色。

ex.en: Blue is a popular color for offices.
ex.zh: 藍色是辦公室常用的顏色。

blue.en: the color of a clear sky

ex.en: I have the blues today.
ex.zh: 我今天心情不太好。

ex.en: I'm feeling a bit blue today.
ex.zh: 我今天心情有點低落。

blue.zh: out of the blue：突然、出乎意料

ex.en: It was like a bolt out of the blue.
ex.zh: 簡直是晴天霹靂。

ex.en: He called me out of the blue.
ex.zh: 他突然打電話給我。

ex.en: I'd like you to have a blood test.
ex.zh: 我希望你去驗個血。

ex.en: Very few people know what their blood group is.
ex.zh: 很少人知道自己是什麼血型。

ex.en: My blue dress appeared with a blood stain.
ex.zh: 我的藍色洋裝上出現了血跡。

blood.en: the red liquid that flows around the body

ex.en: There was a cold wind blowing from the north.
ex.zh: 北方吹來一陣冷風。

ex.en: She had her hat blown off by the wind.
ex.zh: 她的帽子被風吹走了。

blow.en: to move as a stream of air

ex.en: Tom blew out all the candles on the cake.
ex.zh: 湯姆吹熄了蛋糕上所有的蠟燭。

ex.en: Make a wish and blow out the candles.
ex.zh: 許個願，然後吹蠟燭吧。

blow.en: to stop a flame burning by breathing on it

ex.en: Losing the contract was a big blow to the company.
ex.zh: 失去這份合約對公司是一大打擊。

ex.en: His death came as a blow to his family.
ex.zh: 他的死對家人是沉重的打擊。

blow.en: a shock or disappointment that causes trouble

ex.en: They blamed Tom for causing the accident.
ex.zh: 他們指責湯姆造成了事故。

ex.en: He only blames other people, and never himself.
ex.zh: 他只會怪別人，從不檢討自己。

ex.en: It is no use blaming him for the accident now.
ex.zh: 現在怪他造成事故也沒用了。

blame.en: to say that someone is responsible for something bad

ex.en: The manager took the blame for the mistake.
ex.zh: 經理為這個錯誤扛下了責任。

ex.en: Don't put the blame on me.
ex.zh: 別把責任推到我身上。

blame.en: responsibility for something bad that has happened

ex.en: It is you that are to blame for it.
ex.zh: 該負責的是你。

ex.en: Tom and Mary have nobody to blame but themselves.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗只能怪自己。

blame.en: to be responsible for something bad

ex.en: The old man is blind in one eye.
ex.zh: 這位老人一隻眼睛看不見。

ex.en: A blind person's hearing is often very acute.
ex.zh: 盲人的聽覺通常非常敏銳。

ex.en: Tom opened the blinds and looked out the window.
ex.zh: 湯姆拉開百葉窗，往窗外看。

ex.en: Could you close the blinds? The sun is too bright.
ex.zh: 你可以把百葉窗關上嗎？陽光太刺眼了。

blind.en: a covering for a window that can be pulled up or down

ex.en: Love blinded him to her faults.
ex.zh: 愛情讓他看不見她的缺點。

ex.en: He was blinded in an accident.
ex.zh: 他在一次意外中失明了。

blind.en: to make someone unable to see or to understand clearly

ex.en: Because American dramas are very bloody, he doesn't like watching them.
ex.zh: 因為美劇很血腥，所以他不喜歡看。

ex.en: The war was long and bloody.
ex.zh: 那場戰爭漫長又血腥。

ex.en: He had a bloody nose after the fall.
ex.zh: 他跌倒後流鼻血了。

bloody.en: involving much violence, or covered with red liquid from wounds

ex.en: God bless you!
ex.zh: 願上帝保佑你！

ex.en: The priest blessed the newly married couple.
ex.zh: 神父為新婚夫婦祝福。

bless.en: to ask God to protect and help someone

ex.en: I am blessed with good health.
ex.zh: 我很幸運擁有健康的身體。

ex.en: Taiwan is blessed with beautiful mountains.
ex.zh: 台灣得天獨厚，擁有美麗的山。

bless.en: to be lucky to have a good quality or thing

bless.zh: Bless you!：（對打噴嚏的人說）保重

ex.en: "Achoo!" "Bless you!"
ex.zh: 「哈啾！」「保重！」

ex.en: Bless you! Do you need a tissue?
ex.zh: 保重！你需要面紙嗎？

bless.en: said politely to someone who has just sneezed

ex.en: I've just published a new post on my blog.
ex.zh: 我剛在部落格上發表了一篇新文章。

ex.en: I often read English and Chinese blogs online.
ex.zh: 我常上網看英文和中文的部落格。

ex.en: Do you have a blog?
ex.zh: 你有部落格嗎？

blog.en: a website where a person regularly writes their thoughts

ex.en: She blogs about travel and food.
ex.zh: 她在部落格上寫旅遊和美食。

ex.en: I've been blogging for five years.
ex.zh: 我寫部落格已經五年了。

blog.en: to write posts on a personal website

ex.en: We made good time until we ran into a blizzard.
ex.zh: 我們一路順利，直到遇上暴風雪。

ex.en: Because of the blizzard, Tom and Mary were stranded in Boston.
ex.zh: 因為暴風雪，Tom 和 Mary 被困在波士頓。

ex.en: The blizzard has already had a severe impact on the economy.
ex.zh: 這場暴風雪已經對經濟造成嚴重的影響。

blizzard.en: a storm with strong wind and heavy snow

ex.en: I came back from vacation to a blizzard of emails.
ex.zh: 我休假回來，面對一大堆電子郵件。

ex.en: The new rules created a blizzard of paperwork.
ex.zh: 新規定帶來一大堆文書作業。

blizzard.en: a very large amount of things coming at once

ex.en: Possible side effects include blurred vision and shortness of breath.
ex.zh: 可能的副作用包括視力模糊和呼吸急促。

ex.en: Tears blurred her vision.
ex.zh: 淚水模糊了她的視線。

blur.en: to make something difficult to see clearly, or to become unclear

ex.en: Working from home can blur the line between work and life.
ex.zh: 在家工作可能使工作與生活的界線變得模糊。

ex.en: The two roles have become blurred.
ex.zh: 這兩個角色的分界已經變得模糊。

blur.en: to make the difference between two things less clear

blur.zh: 模糊的東西；模糊的記憶

ex.en: The whole week was a blur of meetings.
ex.zh: 整個星期都在一連串會議中模糊地過去了。

ex.en: Without my glasses, everything is a blur.
ex.zh: 沒戴眼鏡時，什麼都是模糊一片。

blur.en: something that cannot be seen or remembered clearly

ex.en: The soup is a bit bland. Can you pass the salt?
ex.zh: 這湯有點淡，可以把鹽遞給我嗎？

ex.en: Hospital food is often bland.
ex.zh: 醫院的伙食通常很淡。

ex.en: This novel is too bland.
ex.zh: 這本小說太乏味了。

ex.en: Life would become bland without you.
ex.zh: 沒有你，我的生活會變得平淡無味。

ex.en: Our math teacher drew a circle on the blackboard.
ex.zh: 我們的數學老師在黑板上畫了一個圓。

ex.en: I erased the blackboard for the teacher.
ex.zh: 我為老師擦黑板。

ex.en: What did Tom write on the blackboard?
ex.zh: 湯姆在黑板上寫了什麼？

blackboard.en: a dark board in a classroom that you write on with chalk

ex.en: To be blunt, your essay needs a lot of work.
ex.zh: 說得直接一點，你的作文需要大幅修改。

ex.en: He is known for his blunt way of speaking.
ex.zh: 他以說話直來直往而聞名。

blunt.en: saying what you think in a direct way, even if it hurts

ex.en: My sword may be blunt, but that's more than enough for someone like you.
ex.zh: 我的劍雖然是鈍的，但應付你的話是綽綽有餘的。

ex.en: Cut the bread with a sharp knife, not a blunt one.
ex.zh: 切麵包要用鋒利的刀，不要用鈍的。

blunt.en: not sharp enough to cut well

ex.en: Bob is very timid and blushes when chatting with girls.
ex.zh: 鮑伯非常膽小，和女生聊天時會臉紅。

ex.en: The man blushed like a boy.
ex.zh: 男人的臉像小孩般紅了起來。

ex.en: You are blushing.
ex.zh: 你臉紅了。

blush.en: to become red in the face because you feel shy or embarrassed

ex.en: The bleak landscape was covered with snow and ice.
ex.zh: 荒涼的景色被冰雪覆蓋。

ex.en: The future looks bleak for the small company.
ex.zh: 這家小公司的前景看起來黯淡。

bleak.en: cold, empty and without hope or comfort

ex.en: The driver was not blameworthy because the brakes failed.
ex.zh: 駕駛不應受責備，因為煞車失靈了。

ex.en: Nobody is blameworthy for an honest mistake.
ex.zh: 誠實犯下的錯誤不該怪罪於任何人。

blameworthy.en: deserving to be criticized for something wrong

ex.en: She has blonde hair and a slim figure.
ex.zh: 她有一頭金髮，身材苗條。

ex.en: She is a beautiful girl with blonde hair and blue eyes.
ex.zh: 她是個美麗的女孩，有著金色頭髮和藍色眼睛。

ex.en: Lidia has straight blonde hair.
ex.zh: 莉迪亞有一頭金色直髮。

ex.en: Blondes earn 7% more than women with any other hair color.
ex.zh: 金髮女性的收入比其他髮色的女性多7%。

ex.en: The blonde sitting by the window is my cousin.
ex.zh: 坐在窗邊的那位金髮女子是我表姐。

blonde.en: a woman with light yellow hair

ex.en: The summer blockbuster broke box office records in its first week.
ex.zh: 這部暑期賣座大片上映第一週就打破票房紀錄。

ex.en: Let's watch a blockbuster with our friends this Saturday.
ex.zh: 我們這週六跟朋友一起去看強檔大片吧。

blockbuster.en: a very successful film or book that many people enjoy

ex.en: Those who count their blessings experience more joy.
ex.zh: 懂得珍惜自己擁有的人，會感受到更多快樂。

ex.en: We consider it a blessing.
ex.zh: 我們把它當作福分。

ex.en: Having good friends nearby is a real blessing.
ex.zh: 身邊有好朋友真的是一種福氣。

blessing.en: something good that you are thankful for

ex.en: They got married with their parents' blessing.
ex.zh: 他們在父母的祝福下結婚了。

ex.en: The priest gave a blessing before the meal.
ex.zh: 神父在用餐前做了祝禱。

blessing.en: approval or good wishes from someone

ex.en: Tom is bluffing.
ex.zh: 湯姆在虛張聲勢。

ex.en: Don't worry, he's just bluffing about quitting his job.
ex.zh: 別擔心，他說要辭職只是在唬人而已。

ex.en: She bluffed her way through the interview with confidence.
ex.zh: 她靠著自信在面試中矇混過關。

bluff.en: to pretend you can or will do something to trick people

ex.en: Walk two blocks, and turn left.
ex.zh: 走過兩個街區，然後左轉。

ex.en: She lives a block away and her name is Susan.
ex.zh: 她住在一個街區之外，名叫蘇珊。

block.en: an area of a town with streets on all four sides

ex.en: After the storm, the road was blocked with fallen trees.
ex.zh: 暴風雨過後，那條路被倒下來的樹堵住了。

ex.en: Traffic was blocked by a landslide.
ex.zh: 交通因為山崩而中斷。

block.en: to stop something from moving through a place

ex.en: The statue was carved from a block of cherry wood.
ex.zh: 這座雕像是由櫻木雕刻而成。

ex.en: The building is made of concrete blocks.
ex.zh: 這棟建築是用混凝土塊蓋的。

block.en: a solid piece of wood, stone or other hard material

ex.en: His wounded leg began to bleed again.
ex.zh: 他受傷的腿又開始流血了。

ex.en: My ear was bleeding this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我耳朵流血了。

ex.en: We have to stop the bleeding.
ex.zh: 我們必須止血。

bleed.en: to lose blood from the body

ex.en: Be careful, the blade is very sharp.
ex.zh: 小心，這刀刃很鋒利。

ex.en: He changed the blade of his razor.
ex.zh: 他換了刮鬍刀的刀片。

ex.en: The fan has three blades.
ex.zh: 這台風扇有三片扇葉。

ex.en: A blade of grass stuck to his shoe.
ex.zh: 一片草葉黏在他的鞋子上。

ex.en: She blinked in the bright sunlight.
ex.zh: 她在強烈的陽光下眨了眨眼。

ex.en: Don't blink, or you will miss the trick.
ex.zh: 別眨眼，不然你會錯過這個魔術。

ex.en: The red light blinked on the screen.
ex.zh: 螢幕上的紅燈在閃爍。

ex.en: Stars blinked in the dark sky.
ex.zh: 星星在黑暗的夜空中閃爍。

ex.en: It all happened in the blink of an eye.
ex.zh: 這一切都發生在眨眼之間。

ex.en: He gave a quick blink and smiled.
ex.zh: 他快速眨了一下眼並微笑。

ex.en: The little boy has blond hair and blue eyes.
ex.zh: 那個小男孩有一頭金髮和藍眼睛。

ex.en: She dyed her hair blond for the summer.
ex.zh: 她為了夏天把頭髮染成金色。

ex.en: The tall blond in the photo is my cousin.
ex.zh: 照片中那個高個子金髮男生是我的表哥。

ex.en: A blond waved at us from across the street.
ex.zh: 一位金髮男子從街對面向我們揮手。

ex.en: He seems like a nice bloke.
ex.zh: 他看起來是個不錯的傢伙。

ex.en: A bloke at the pub told us about a good restaurant.
ex.zh: 酒館裡有個傢伙告訴我們一家好餐廳。

ex.en: The bladder stores urine until we go to the toilet.
ex.zh: 膀胱會儲存尿液，直到我們去上廁所。

ex.en: The doctor checked her bladder for infection.
ex.zh: 醫生檢查她的膀胱有沒有發炎。

ex.en: Blackpool is a seaside town in the northwest of England.
ex.zh: 黑潭是英格蘭西北部的海濱城鎮。

ex.en: Many British families visit Blackpool for its beach and tower.
ex.zh: 許多英國家庭會到黑潭玩，欣賞它的海灘和高塔。

ex.en: The cherry tree was covered in pink blossoms.
ex.zh: 櫻花樹上開滿了粉紅色的花。

ex.en: The garden is in full blossom this week.
ex.zh: 這個星期花園裡的花正盛開。

ex.en: The plum trees blossom in early spring.
ex.zh: 梅樹在初春開花。

ex.en: She blossomed into a confident young woman.
ex.zh: 她逐漸成長為一位有自信的年輕女性。

ex.en: The cherry trees bloom in early spring.
ex.zh: 櫻花樹在早春開花。

ex.en: These roses bloom all summer long.
ex.zh: 這些玫瑰整個夏天都會開花。

ex.en: Every bloom in the garden was covered in rain drops.
ex.zh: 花園裡每一朵花都沾滿了雨滴。

ex.en: The tree is in full bloom this week.
ex.zh: 這棵樹這個星期正值盛開。

ex.en: She wore a white blouse with a black skirt.
ex.zh: 她穿著白色襯衫配黑色裙子。

ex.en: This silk blouse needs to be washed by hand.
ex.zh: 這件絲質襯衫必須用手洗。

ex.en: Press a clean cloth on the cut to stop the bleeding.
ex.zh: 用乾淨的布按住傷口來止血。

ex.en: Heavy bleeding after the accident required immediate treatment.
ex.zh: 事故後大量出血，需要立刻治療。

ex.en: Firefighters fought the blaze for several hours.
ex.zh: 消防員奮力撲滅這場大火好幾個小時。

ex.en: We sat around the warm blaze in the fireplace.
ex.zh: 我們圍坐在壁爐溫暖的火焰旁。

ex.en: The campfire blazed all night in the cold air.
ex.zh: 營火在寒冷的空氣中整夜熊熊燃燒。

ex.en: The sun blazed down on the empty beach.
ex.zh: 太陽熾熱地照在空蕩蕩的海灘上。

ex.zh: 軍隊以不流血的方式接管了這座城市。

ex.en: The kids played basketball on the blacktop.
ex.zh: 孩子們在柏油地面上打籃球。

ex.en: The blacktop was hot under the summer sun.
ex.zh: 柏油路面在夏日陽光下很燙。

ex.en: The boxer's face was bloodied after the fight.
ex.zh: 拳擊手打完比賽後滿臉是血。

ex.en: He wiped his bloodied hands on a towel.
ex.zh: 他把沾血的雙手在毛巾上擦了擦。

ex.en: The couple sat blissfully on the beach.
ex.zh: 這對情侶幸福地坐在海灘上。

ex.en: He slept blissfully through the loud thunderstorm.
ex.zh: 他在轟隆的雷雨中睡得香甜，渾然不覺。

ex.en: He lost all his money playing blackjack.
ex.zh: 他玩二十一點輸光了所有的錢。

ex.en: Blackjack is a card game in which you try to reach twenty-one.
ex.zh: 二十一點是一種要湊到二十一點的紙牌遊戲。

ex.en: Blending different colors can make a new shade.
ex.zh: 把不同顏色調和可以做出新的色調。

ex.en: The blending of old and new styles makes the building special.
ex.zh: 新舊風格的融合讓這棟建築很特別。

ex.en: His eyes were bloodshot after a night without sleep.
ex.zh: 他一夜沒睡，眼睛布滿血絲。

ex.en: Allergies left her eyes red and bloodshot.
ex.zh: 過敏讓她的眼睛又紅又充血。

ex.en: The investigation showed the driver was blameless.
ex.zh: 調查顯示那位駕駛毫無過失。

ex.en: She led a quiet, blameless life.
ex.zh: 她過著平靜而無可挑剔的生活。

blurring.zh: 使模糊（blur 的現在分詞）

ex.en: Tears were blurring her vision as she read the letter.
ex.zh: 她讀信時淚水模糊了視線。

ex.en: The rain kept blurring the lines on the road.
ex.zh: 雨水一直讓路上的標線變得模糊不清。

ex.en: The photographer is blurring the background to make the flower stand out.
ex.zh: 攝影師把背景弄模糊，好讓花朵更突出。

ex.en: It was a cold, blustery day, and my umbrella blew inside out.
ex.zh: 那天又冷又風大，我的傘被吹得翻了過來。

ex.en: We stayed indoors because of the blustery weather.
ex.zh: 因為天氣風大，我們待在室內。

ex.en: My grandmother makes blackcurrant jam every summer.
ex.zh: 我奶奶每年夏天都會做黑醋栗果醬。

ex.en: I ordered a glass of blackcurrant juice with ice.
ex.zh: 我點了一杯加冰塊的黑醋栗汁。

ex.en: The blackcurrant bushes at the back of the garden are full of fruit.
ex.zh: 花園後面的黑醋栗叢結滿了果實。

ex.en: The old bridge was blown up to make way for a new one.
ex.zh: 舊橋被炸毀，好為新橋讓路。

ex.en: The gas tank could blow up if it gets too hot.
ex.zh: 瓦斯桶過熱的話可能會爆炸。

blow up.en: to explode or destroy something with an explosion

ex.en: We spent an hour blowing up balloons for the party.
ex.zh: 我們花了一小時為派對吹氣球。

ex.en: Can you blow up this beach ball for me?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我把這顆海灘球充氣嗎？

ex.en: Dad blew up when he saw the broken window.
ex.zh: 爸爸看到破掉的窗戶時大發雷霆。

ex.en: Don't blow up at me; it wasn't my fault.
ex.zh: 別對我發火，那不是我的錯。

ex.en: I want to blow up this photo and hang it on the wall.
ex.zh: 我想把這張照片放大掛在牆上。

ex.en: They blew up the map so everyone could see it.
ex.zh: 他們把地圖放大，讓每個人都看得到。

ex.en: The strong wind blew away my hat.
ex.zh: 強風把我的帽子吹走了。

ex.en: Dry leaves blew away across the empty street.
ex.zh: 枯葉被吹過空蕩的街道。

blow away.en: to be carried away by wind, or to carry something away

ex.en: She blew out all the candles on the cake.
ex.zh: 她把蛋糕上所有的蠟燭都吹熄了。

ex.en: The wind blew out the small fire before we could cook.
ex.zh: 風在我們煮東西前就把小火吹熄了。

blow out.en: to stop a flame by blowing on it

ex.en: One of our tires blew out on the highway.
ex.zh: 我們有一個輪胎在高速公路上爆了。

ex.en: The old tire blew out because it was too thin.
ex.zh: 那條舊輪胎因為太薄而爆開了。

blow out.en: to burst suddenly, especially a tire

ex.en: He was the black sheep of the family because he quit school.
ex.zh: 他因為輟學而成了家裡的害群之馬。

ex.en: My uncle is the black sheep who never follows family traditions.
ex.zh: 我叔叔是家裡的異類，從不遵守家族傳統。

black sheep.en: a person who is seen as bad or different in a group
